description: From fixed costs, the variable cost per unit, and the selling price per unit, compute the break-even point: the unit count and revenue at which profit is exactly zero. The price must exceed the variable cost, since otherwise every unit sold loses money and break-even is never reached no matter the volume. Optionally pass a sales volume to also get the profit (or loss) at that volume and the margin of safety above break-even. Pure arithmetic, no live cost/pricing feed.

fixedCosts.description: Total fixed costs for the period (cannot be negative)

pricePerUnit.description: Selling price per unit (must be greater than variableCostPerUnit)

salesVolume.description: Optional actual/planned unit sales, to compute profit and margin of safety at that volume

variableCostPerUnit.description: Variable cost to produce one unit (cannot be negative)

name: calculate_break_even
